properties.notes: Planning permission was granted in October 2013 for the conversion of the upper floors of the building to form 14 residential units (BDB/75489). A further application has since been granted for one additional flat (16/02676/FUL in September 2016). The site is under construction and is due to be completed in 2019/20. The site is deliverable within five years.. Change of use of 1st and 2nd floors to create 14 no. 2-bed flats and 1no. 2-bed flat at 2nd floor
